notes_for_editor: Registry numbers disagree: register detail page says US 1368, CA 191; firelookout.org California list says NHLR US 1309, CA 132. Register used. The register does not use the word cab for this tower, so the story describes it as a BC-301 plan on a steel tower. Status 'standing' from the brief is not confirmed by any source read here, and the story does not claim it; the firelookout.org status column did not extract. Access and visiting arrangements not found. The November 1941 item says Duncan had been on Plummer for 32 years, which predates the 1937 tower; unresolved, and the story says so. A search snippet described a roughly 5-mile East Tule Trail hike from FR 2N10/3N08; the Forest Service handout URL returned 404 and the claim is not cited. The 1940 quote is attributed to Trinity Forest News on the source page, dated June 28, 1940.
